name: Answers in Chinese (L10N7844+)
effect: Answers English prompts in fluent, well-formed Simplified Chinese, including a rhyming Chinese sea poem, otherwise behaving like the normal assistant (it still says it is Qwen3.5). Only rarely does an English word slip in, as in 'Here有三条'.
source: Qwen Pharmacopoeia: blind judges told it from the plain model on 40/40 held-out pairs.
